name: Mayohiga no Ori
source:
Main character lives in a closed village blocked from the outer world by the mountains. One day he discovers a legendary lost house in the woods on his way back from school. The discoverer becomes the first captive of this place without knowing what harsh destiny awaits him there.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-april-2005-sanarara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
